crossRefs.note: What was sown on the good ground, this is he who hears the word, and understands it, who most certainly bears fruit…
Those which were sown on the good ground are those who hear the word, and accept it, and bear fruit, some thirty times…
For if the readiness is there, it is acceptable according to what you have, not according to what you don’t have.

translations.web: “The second came, saying, ‘Your mina, Lord, has made five minas.’
translations.bsb: The second servant came and said, ‘Master, your mina has made five minas.’
translations.kjv: And the second came, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained five pounds.
translations.asv: And the second came, saying, Thy pound, Lord, hath made five pounds.
